title: Part Six: Homeland Security, ICE and the Police

sections.brief: The DHS–Israel instruments: the 2007 Chertoff–Dichter memorandum, the 2014 Act's research pilots, BIRD HLS, and the FY2022 NDAA cybersecurity grant program; what each does, what the US gets, what is not public. Figures: time; compare.

Police exchanges run by GILEE, JINSA and the ADL: scale, funding, stated purpose, the critics' case (Amnesty USA, JVP as a party), the evidence gap, and the cities and agencies that withdrew. Figures: stats; compare; time.
The NYPD's Kfar Saba office (2007/2012 to 2026) and ICE's purchases of Israeli-made phone tools (Cellebrite, Paragon), with the asymmetry stated. Figures: flow; time.
